item.title: KV Cache is the New Memory Wall: 57x TTFT Reduction at 16k Context
item.description: Without prefix caching, doubling context length more than doubles your time-to-first-token. At 16k tokens, prefill consumes 60% of total latency — 6.3 seconds of waiting. Prefix caching cuts that to 111ms. Here’s the data.
